introduction: We are going to do a series of exercises to work on your balance, cardiovascular fitness, flexibility and strength. I will first give you a description of the exercise and then show you a video for you to follow along with. We will do two sets of each exercise with 30 seconds break in between each. If you feel like you need a break or an exercise is too challenging it’s OK to sit down and skip some of the exercises. If you feel really tired, light headed, shortness of breath or any discomfort please stop exercising and sit down until you feel better.

series_1.introduction: Our first series of exercises will work on cardio. You may do them slower or faster than the demonstration as you like.

ex1.text: We’ll start with some low punches. These can be done sitting or standing.

series_2.introduction: Alright Bill, now we are going to do some balance exercises. It is important that you have a chair nearby to grab onto if you lose your balance. If an exercise is too challenging for you it’s OK to skip it.

ex1.text: We’ll start with an easy exercise that just requires you to stand quietly with your feet close together.

ending: Great job Bill you’ve completed all the exercises!  We’ll do them again in a few days
